condition.label: Amber
condition.action: Market conditions are mixed or participation is too narrow for Green. Trade only when the stock setup and entry trigger are strong.

methodology.rag_model: Market RAG scores ONEQ 10-session momentum (2 points), five-session direction of the 10-day breadth ratio (2), five-session direction of S&P 500 50-day participation (1), and ONEQ 10MA above 20MA (1).
methodology.rag_thresholds: Green 5-6; Amber 3-4; Red 0-2. If fewer than 30% of S&P 500 constituents are above their 50-day MA, Green is capped at Amber.
methodology.entry_separation: The market RAG describes the environment only. It does not authorise a trade; stock setup, Momentum Architecture/ORB PASS and the 30-minute ORH entry trigger remain separate requirements.
methodology.high_momentum: Close more than 45% above its close 10 sessions earlier.
methodology.sp500_50ma: Percent of S&P 500 constituents closing above their own 50-session moving average.
methodology.note: IEX is a single-exchange feed and may materially undercount volume-based breadth versus consolidated SIP data.
